title: Climate change, healthy diets, and fragmented delivery systems
discussion_signal: The post presents nutrition as a climate, food-system, health, financing, governance, and data problem. It emphasizes that integrated delivery and unequal resource access matter alongside production and dietary advice.
linked_research_question: How do climate, food, health, financing, and delivery systems interact to determine access to healthy diets?
limits: Post summarizes a report rather than presenting new estimates
Global framing can hide regional and household differences
Systems recommendations do not establish implementation effectiveness
